mo_ta_cong_viec:
Join our dynamic team and kickstart your career in project management! As an intern, you’ll gain hands-on experience supporting IT and digital transformation projects, working closely with senior project managers and cross-functional teams. 
 
What You’ll Experience 
• Assist in documenting project requirements, schedules, and reports. 
• Support workshops, meetings, and stakeholder communications. 
• Help track risks, issues, and milestones. 
• Collaborate with development, testing, infrastructure and related teams. 
• Contribute to monitoring project execution and reporting. 
• Participate in technical and business discussions. 
• Assist in preparing governance and compliance documentation 
 
Why This Internship? 
• Gain hands-on project management experience before graduation. 
• Receive mentorship from experienced project managers. 
• Learn to work with cutting-edge tools and industry-standard workflows. 
• Build a strong foundation to launch your career in project management.
yeu_cau:
• Final-year Student or recent graduate in IT, Computer Science, Business Administration, or related fields. 
• Basic knowledge of project management concepts (Agile/Scrum preferred). 
• Strong communication, organization, and teamwork skills. 
• Curious, proactive, and excited to grow in a fast-moving tech environment 
• English proficiency (IELTS 6.5+ or equivalent) 
• Availability for full-time internship (expected 4-5 days/week)
